C9.2.note: The recommendations about real approval elections need two assumptions. First, that the submitted approval ballots equal the approval sets generated from ideal points, i.e. sincere voting; this is never stated. Second, that judgments of rule quality relative to ideal points reflect voters' interests; this is only partly stated.
